name: Környe (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Környe (a red and green shield with a church, a plough, an ear of grain and a bunch of grapes, within a yellow frame, above a yellow scroll inscribed KÖRNYE) below the year 1238 in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Környe arms with frame and scroll
